title: The new café
instructions: Yeni bir kafenin sahibi kafesini tanıtıyor. Saatler, fiyatlar ve günleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: owner
script.text: Hello! I'm Luca, and this is my new café, Luca's Corner. We opened last week.

script.speaker: owner
script.text: We're open every day from eight in the morning to six in the evening, but on Sundays we close at three.

script.speaker: owner
script.text: We have coffee, tea, fresh juice and homemade cakes.

script.speaker: owner
script.text: A coffee is two pounds fifty, and a piece of cake is three pounds.

script.speaker: owner
script.text: From Monday to Friday, coffee is half price before nine o'clock.

script.speaker: owner
script.text: We don't have a big kitchen, so we don't make hot food. But we have sandwiches.

questions.prompt: What time does the café close on Sundays?
questions.feedback: Her gün altıda kapanıyor ama pazar üçte.
questions.evidence: but on Sundays we close at three.

questions.prompt: How much is a piece of cake?
questions.feedback: Bir dilim pasta üç pound; kahve iki pound elli.
questions.evidence: a piece of cake is three pounds.

questions.feedback: Hafta içi saat dokuzdan önce kahve yarı fiyat.
questions.evidence: From Monday to Friday, coffee is half price before nine o'clock.

questions.prompt: Why doesn't the café have hot food?
questions.feedback: Mutfak büyük değil; sıcak yemek yapmıyorlar.
